Unpopular opinion: you should never pre-order a game.

Cyberpunk 2077 launched so broken that Sony pulled it from the PlayStation Store. No Man's Sky got great after years of patches. Buying at launch meant paying for a promise. Fallout 76 shipped rough too. Digital copies never sell out, so wait for reviews. Agree?
